entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider offering multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents. It utilizes hybrid retrieval combining semantic, keyword, and entity matching with time-aware capabilities to track current and past events.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for high-efficiency recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance with built-in connectors for Notion, GitHub, Google Drive, and other productivity tools.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official context database that uses a filesystem paradigm and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to significantly reduce token costs. It provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated substantial gains in task completion on the LoCoMo10 benchmark.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agent that synthesizes cited answers across complex ideas and entities. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph that extracts typed relationships without LLM calls and runs automated background cycles for memory consolidation.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent growth. It acts as an LLM wrapper that automates storage and retrieval across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A stateful agent library that asynchronously extracts reasoning-based conclusions from conversations and events. It tracks evolving entities such as users and ideas, providing prompt-ready context via Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, enabling version control through branching and merging of markdown context trees. It delivers high-speed, sub-100ms access via a 5-tier retrieval system.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, SQLite-backed memory system designed for sub-millisecond performance. It integrates with MCP for agentic tool support and features temporal knowledge graphs and episodic compression.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that refines agent performance through evaluation and lesson retention. It generates filesystem-first traces and playbooks to distill successful behaviors into local models via training plans.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin using a SQLite-backed DAG to maintain hierarchical summaries without losing raw message lineage. It includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand for precise recall within bounded active prompts.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private, cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers and OpenAI-compatible providers, including an automated Docker and PostgreSQL setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems utilizing an open, human-readable YAML engram format. It supports hierarchical scoping for team-specific knowledge and integrates with MCP tools like Claude Code.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other MCP clients. It uses SQLite for custody and includes tools to manually edit, delete, or reclassify context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that eliminates cloud dependencies and API keys for total local privacy. It employs hybrid retrieval using BM25, vector search, and graph traversal via MCP server and Hermes plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases cache hits by 4–12× through prefix reordering and deduplication. It reduces input tokens by approximately 36% for long-context workloads in SGLang, vLLM, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable retrieval using why_retrieved tags and contradiction tracking. It ensures memory hygiene through automated stale scans and maintains a native outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide bounded evidence packing.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first architecture with SQLite-vec and GGUF models, operating as an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that indexes files, URLs, and codebases using automated tagging and summarization. It utilizes edge tags for navigable relationships and tracks agent intentions through reflective skill instructions.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It prioritizes high-priority memories during prefetch and supports GLiNER2 for entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of memories without residual summaries. It provides transparency through a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider featuring semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports automatic memory mirroring from native Hermes tools and utilizes session snapshots with TTL support.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and searching, with support for query expansion and result reranking.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A comprehensive suite of 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It combines BM25, vector, and graph search methods with automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system that generates HTML prototypes, motion graphics, and PPTX decks. It integrates with coding agents like Hermes to bridge the gap between design and implementation.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to major frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It provides Hermes Agent with structured expertise across 29 security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Converts natural language and Mermaid text into native .drawio XML diagrams. It is ideal for visualizing codebase structures, class hierarchies, and cloud infrastructure manifests.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit modes. It uses a tiered word replacement table to ensure content feels human-authored.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables skills to evolve collectively through automatic deduplication and quality improvements. It creates a shared evolution loop for distributing optimized skills across teams.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library offering specialized skill collections for UX design and sales influence. These are easily installable via CLI or the Claude plugin marketplace.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI. It utilizes progressive disclosure of metadata to reduce token consumption during skill loading.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Enables Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, search videos, and browse playlists without relying on yt-dlp. It provides precise timestamp and caption extraction for video analysis.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts using dynamic 'prisms' for resilience and optimization. It includes constraint reporting to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A structured workflow that transforms rough ideas into formal design documents and implementation handoffs. It features Lite and Full modes with a dedicated PASS/FAIL review gate.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A Rust-based harness for long-running agents featuring structured DAG-based task management and SQLite storage. It uses explicit claim and verification gates to ensure execution accuracy.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source code and automatically syncs edits between the two.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Integrates Hermes Agent with the Chainlink Oracle network for smart contract interactions. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds via the agentskills.io specification.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official integration for FLUX image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines and API patterns. It supports precise hex color specification and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It maps instructions to specific file lines and pinned commits for high provenance.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills featuring an OpenAPI-driven SDK and CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution and integrated payment flows via Stripe and TON.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Facilitates the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery from failures.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent server management and hot reloading.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Allows Hermes Agent to manage Nextcloud files, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It ensures secure communication using HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: Rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel sub-agents to hunt for bugs and exploits. It integrates Semgrep and Bandit for deterministic pre-scanning without modifying the source code.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and progressive disclosure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, synonyms, and dense embeddings to find the most relevant skills. This narrows skill lists before LLM calls to significantly reduce token usage.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to prevent dangerous modifications.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapts verified procedures for grounding and evidence-based verification. It uses a Python goal engine to manage persistent task state and prevent early-stop errors.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills based on the ARD v0.9 specification. It integrates federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows agents to search over 13,000 MCP servers and 4,000 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402 for seamless agent-to-agent transactions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for a wide variety of AI coding agents, including Hermes, ensuring users always have access to the latest versions. It simplifies deployment by allowing agents to be executed directly via nix run commands without manual installation.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It uniquely leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-native distribution requires no installation, admin rights, or Docker, making it the most accessible option for desktop users. It features a built-in workflow engine and over 100 integrated tools, including TTS and ComfyUI, for automated local pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Designed for rapid mobile deployment, this project uses a one-line script to set up Hermes Agent within the Termux environment. It prioritizes privacy and low latency by supporting local AI execution through Ollama alongside 200+ cloud-based models.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables cloud-native deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on state safety. It enforces single-writer persistence for agent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security environments by providing hardware-level enforcement of network, filesystem, and process boundaries. It offers three distinct security presets and integrates with external platforms like Discord and VS Code via the Agent Control Protocol.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a streamlined Docker sandbox that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific agent versions using Docker build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative management of Hermes configurations, documents, and systemd services for reproducible deployments. It features robust secrets handling via sops-nix and supports a hybrid model for both Nix-managed and interactive CLI skills.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-based control plane for orchestrating multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces. It is built for scale, offering hierarchy-aware task delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is optimized for headless operation, allowing the agent to execute autonomous cron jobs and integrate with the Nous Portal.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: This deployment stack integrates Hermes into the Portainer UI as a Git-managed repository for easy container management. It includes ttyd to provide a convenient web-based terminal interface for interacting with the agent through any browser.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration dashboard that manages multi-agent workflows across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a secure, zero-dependency environment featuring integrated secret detection and spend monitoring.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A TUI and PWA control surface designed for managing diverse coding agents within sandboxed Docker or Podman containers. It enables parallel execution across multiple git worktrees and repositories for high-scale development.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template that scales Hermes agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for efficient delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: A level-based scaling template for Hermes Agent that facilitates the transition from individual agents to orchestrated teams. It employs a task bus for agent handoffs and provides built-in skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Hermes and Ollama. It features durable memory and the ability for agents to learn new skills directly from conversations.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A supervision interface for Hermes agents that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and review queues. It ensures quality through live streaming of agent reasoning and mandatory human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized pipeline of 17 agents dedicated to end-to-end software development, from research to infrastructure. It enforces strict quality and security gates and integrates MCP servers for web fetching and documentation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols. It provides a real-time Web UI to monitor agent dialogues and manage task flows via an integrated Kanban system.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness that uses automated outer-loop searches to refine agent code based on arXiv research. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track and improve performance frontiers.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It orchestrates nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, visualizing their tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation system that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool builds local semantic knowledge graphs to provide Hermes Agent with cross-file code intelligence. By using surgical context retrieval and real-time index syncing, it significantly reduces token usage and the number of tool calls required for complex coding tasks.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility and 3D visualization dashboard designed to track token consumption and costs across multiple AI agents, including Hermes. It features a native Rust TUI that helps developers monitor their spending and usage patterns in real-time.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent, including system prompts, tool schemas, and streaming responses. It facilitates debugging through structured diffs that compare adjacent requests to identify subtle changes in agent behavior.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI is an MCP server that supplies Hermes Agent with curated design systems, layout guidance, and UI-specific prompts. It enables the agent to build better user interfaces by providing specialized design skills and structured layout constraints.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agent roles through a central CTO loop to automate the entire application lifecycle. It includes 36 built-in skills for deployment, monitoring, and GitHub integration, moving projects from initial brief to production.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins provides a collection of community-driven themes and CLI visuals to customize the Hermes terminal interface with unique banners and ASCII art. Users can easily create or inherit themes using YAML configuration files for either session-based or permanent visual upgrades.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce by supporting secure SOL and USDC payments on the Solana blockchain.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF handling, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is a Chromium-based browser built for autonomous agent control, allowing developers to watch Hermes execute tasks within a standard web interface. It supports persistent sessions with action rollbacks and provides agents with structured page metadata for more reliable navigation.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations, local memories, and project-specific tools. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents to maintain strict context boundaries within a workspace.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes preconfigured with over 40 skills for finance, research, and DevOps, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: Evey-setup provides an automated installer that deploys a full Hermes Agent stack along with 12 supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins to expand agent functionality at zero cost.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that uses deterministic scanning to identify failure modes in agent configurations and system prompts without making LLM calls. It employs seven structural detectors to score prompts against the HERM v1.1 standard across multiple file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility automates the transfer of agent personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to the Hermes YAML format. It ensures a smooth transition by handling the mapping of complex model configurations and local environment credentials.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems, offering real-time telemetry and health monitoring for Hermes Agent via a dedicated plugin. It features automated circuit breakers and recovery protocols to manage memory bloat and cost drift without cloud dependencies.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A lightweight Tauri-based manager that provides a unified desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other major CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini. It simplifies cross-platform usage on Windows, macOS, and Linux by acting as a centralized hub for multiple agentic environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local cowork application offers a comprehensive GUI for Hermes Agent and over 13 other CLI agents, featuring a built-in engine for web search and MCP tool integration. It distinguishes itself with automated document generation capabilities, allowing users to create editable PPT, Word, and Excel files directly through the agent.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A lightweight Python and JavaScript web interface designed to mirror the full Hermes CLI experience on mobile and desktop browsers. It features a functional three-panel layout that allows users to chat, manage sessions, and browse their workspace files simultaneously.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A dedicated companion app that streamlines the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and dependency resolution. It provides a unified GUI for managing 14 distinct toolsets, including web browsing and code execution, alongside session history and profile management.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: This dashboard focuses on multi-platform connectivity, allowing users to configure Hermes Agent for use across Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It supports isolated profiles for distinct models and memory, featuring detailed tool call inspection and markdown rendering for local sessions.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace that introduces a 'Swarm Mode' for role-based dispatching using tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-powered file browser and a PTY terminal with a specialized memory browser and MCP catalog for advanced development workflows.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that prioritizes direct system access via real SSH and terminal connections to local or remote Hermes hosts. It includes specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and system repair tasks, making it ideal for power users managing remote environments.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted dashboard that serves as a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and monitoring agent health. It features a 'ZOO Swarm Monitor' and a Kanban pipeline view to track complex agentic workflows and system metrics in real-time.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: Built with Tauri and Rust, this Windows-optimized desktop application provides a localized interface for managing both local and cloud model providers. It offers advanced UI components for monitoring tasks, skills, and memory, specifically tailored for the Chinese-speaking developer community.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension bridges the gap between web browsing and Hermes Agent by syncing tools and memory directly into the browser. It allows the agent to capture page text, metadata, and URLs for context-aware prompting without leaving the active tab.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed for transcript inspection and analytics across Hermes and other coding agents. It stands out by providing live quota tracking and burn-rate analytics to help users monitor the costs and resource usage of active agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This macOS workspace is designed for Orgo cloud computers, offering one-click automated Hermes installation on fresh cloud VMs. It features a unique WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime for hands-free interaction with the agent.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that brings a terminal-centric management style to Hermes Agent. It combines markdown and LaTeX rendering with Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic work and managing profiles and skills from the command line.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that functions as a Telegram Mini App, providing a terminal-style chat interface with vision support. It allows users to spawn up to five concurrent background agent instances while monitoring real-time system metrics like CPU and disk usage.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows solution that bundles Hermes Agent with 100 tools, including ComfyUI and TTS, without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a workflow engine for building multi-step automation pipelines and supports local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that emphasizes visual aesthetics while providing real-time log streaming and task tracking. It includes integrated tools for managing MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs within a modern, self-hosted dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring and configuration, utilizing WebSockets for real-time status updates on agent activity. It provides full-text search capabilities for inspecting conversation histories and a visual interface for scheduling agentic cron jobs.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace that utilizes SSE streaming and tool approval cards to give users fine-grained control over agent actions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering new skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents via a PM orchestrator. It includes a visual 'Skill Store' for one-click installations of over 50 curated capabilities, making it a robust environment for complex, multi-expert tasks.
